title: Container type
purpose: Review one version of a box grid: geometry, label preview, its other versions and history.
summary: One version of a box grid: its geometry, a label preview, its other versions and history.

tasks.title: Check how positions are labelled
steps: Read the Label preview, as seen from the labelled top-left corner.

tasks.title: Change the grid
steps: Admin and manager: select [[New version]]. Saving with the same code creates the next version.

good_to_know: A grid is fixed once any box uses it. A change is a new version.
Grids larger than 12 × 12 preview only the top-left 12 × 12.
Numbering order fixes each position's number.
Open [[History]] and use [[Next page]] if you need to see older changes.

sections.title: Container type
paragraphs: A grid is fixed once any box uses it; a change is a new version and existing boxes keep their positions and labels. While no box uses this version its grid can still be corrected.

items.label: Code and version
items.description: The code is shared by every version.

items.label: Position labels
items.description: Letter rows with numbered columns (A1), or numbered positions (1, 2, 3 ...).

items.label: Numbering order
items.description: Across rows (row-major) or down columns (column-major), from the top-left corner; this fixes each position's number.

sections.title: Label preview
paragraphs: The labels as seen from the labelled top-left corner. Grids larger than 12 × 12 show only the top-left 12 × 12.

sections.title: Versions
paragraphs: Every version of this code with its name, grid and status; select another version to open it.

items.label: New version
items.description: Opens the container type form pre-filled from this version; saving with the same code creates the next version.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Opens the edit form for this version.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: Each entry shows the action, its time, who made the change and any reason given. History cannot be edited or deleted. If there are no entries, the panel shows No recorded changes yet.

History shows the latest changes first, with up to 50 entries per page. Within each page, entries run from oldest to newest. If there are more than 50 changes, the heading shows the total. Next page shows older changes and Previous page shows newer ones. First page returns to the latest changes and Last page opens the oldest.
On opening the record, History starts collapsed if it has more than five entries. Select the heading to open or close it. Using a History page link keeps History open.
